name: DayZero
howToRedeploy: deploy using deploy.manifest.json (5 esm modules + ./public assets, spa: true)
notes: The D1 schema is created by worker/store.js on first use, so a fresh database needs no migration step.
worker/schema.sql remains the canonical copy for anyone applying it by hand with `wrangler d1 execute`.
No secrets are configured: email is in capture mode and the optional AI rewrite is off.
